description: Fáze 15: the ONE notation catalog behind both the "Open in editor" palette (the pinned stencil library) and the preview legend — the notation profile's semantic types mapped to diagram stencils through the shared IModelingStencilMapper. Resolution is memoized per notation; legend entries are filtered to the types the generated document actually uses (nodes through their semanticType data, edges through the connector type of their mapped edge stencil). Registered as a singleton by AddTempoBlazorModeling.
